headline: SILVER SELLOFF WARNING: UBS Cuts Year-End Target to $80 as $72/oz Price Triggers Industrial Demand Destruction
snippet: Silver's ~140% price surge over the past year has begun eroding industrial demand, with UBS warning buyers are actively substituting away from the metal at current levels. The bank cut its year-end target to $80/oz and called the investment case 'unappealing' relative to volatility — a stark reversal from January's all-time high of $121.64/oz, which has since crashed nearly 40%.

headline: IRAN WAR RIPPLE: Sulphuric Acid Prices Double in Key Regions — Over Half of Global Critical Minerals Output Now Exposed
snippet: Sulphur prices have surged more than 50% since the Iran war began, with sulphuric acid — the essential input for HPAL nickel and lithium processing — more than doubling in Indonesia ($380/t) and Chile ($440/t). Benchmark Mineral Intelligence warns sulphur now represents 42% of HPAL nickel production costs, and more than half of 2026's forecast critical minerals output is exposed to the ongoing disruption.

headline: COPPER MINE RECKONING: Panama Releases Final First Quantum Audit Today Amid Renewed Protests — 350,000-Tonne Market Awaits Verdict
snippet: Panama's government released its final independent audit of the shuttered Cobre Panamá mine today as anti-mining protests resurface and political pressure builds on President Mulino to rule on the mine's fate. Before its 2023 closure, Cobre Panamá produced 350,000 tonnes of copper annually and contributed ~5% of Panama's GDP — First Quantum has tabulated $3.5 billion in lost economic contribution since shutdown.

headline: RICK RULE: Gold Pullback Below $4,500 Is 'Heaven-Sent' — M&A Wave Building as Majors Scramble to Replace Depleting Reserves
snippet: Rule Investment Media's Rick Rule told Kitco that gold's slip below $4,500/oz for the first time since March changes the entry point, not the thesis — calling the pullback 'heaven-sent' for patient investors with five- to ten-year horizons. He argues the bigger story is accelerating M&A pressure: producers generating record margins are still failing to replace reserves organically, forcing acquisitions.

headline: COPPER RUSH TO COMEX: Tariff Arbitrage Revives as US Premium Hits $500/t Over LME — Traders Redirecting Every Spare Tonne to US Ports
snippet: The Comex-LME copper spread has blown out to over $500/tonne — its widest since autumn 2025 — reviving the tariff arbitrage trade that once flooded US ports and drained global inventories. Traders say they are shipping 'every spare ton' ahead of a June 30 Commerce Department review that could extend tariffs to refined copper, with imports potentially bouncing back to 150,000–200,000 tonnes per month.

headline: QUAD STRIKES BACK: US, Japan, Australia, India Pledge $20B to Break China's 90% Grip on Rare Earth Processing
snippet: At the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on May 26, the four nations unveiled a $20 billion framework covering mining, processing and recycling of critical minerals across the Indo-Pacific. The initiative directly targets China's dominance — Beijing currently processes roughly 90% of the world's rare earths — and comes days after China's export control regime showed little sign of easing post-Trump-Xi summit.

headline: Asian Metals Wrap May 26: Gold Consolidates at $4,450–$4,500, Silver Seeks a Floor, Copper Absorbs Dual Tariff and Supply Pressure
snippet: GoldSeek's May 26 Asian market update covers daily price action across precious and base metals, with gold trading in a consolidation band near $4,500 support, silver attempting to stabilise after its historic crash from January's $121 all-time high, and copper holding near recent highs amid competing forces of US tariff-driven import demand and global supply tightness linked to the Iran conflict.

headline: SUREBET EXPANSION: Goliath Resources Launches Fully Funded 50,000m Drill at Golden Triangle Discovery — Every Single Hole Has Hit Gold
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSX-V: GOT) has mobilised for its largest-ever 50,000m expansion campaign at the Surebet gold discovery in BC's Golden Triangle, targeting the motherlode feeder beneath 46 confirmed gold-bearing stacked lodes across five major zones. Every hole drilled to date — spanning 64,364m in 2025 alone — intersected gold, and visible gold appears in 92% of drill holes.

headline: Abitibi Metals Hits B26's Best-Ever Copper-Gold Intercept: 4.04% CuEq Over 14m Inside 46.7m at 1.48% CuEq in Quebec
snippet: Abitibi Metals Corp. (CSE: AMQ) reported a new best-ever drill result at B26 in western Quebec: 4.04% CuEq over 14m within a broader 1.48% CuEq over 46.7m — exceeding the current block model grade in the Western Down-Plunge Zone and confirming the high-grade domain is growing with every drill. Discovery Silver holds a strategic stake; the resource improvement campaign is outperforming expectations.

headline: $2.9B FEDERAL BACKSTOP: US Only Domestic Antimony Reserve Gets Full Funding — Perpetua Resources' Stibnite Project Is a Go
snippet: The US Export-Import Bank approved a $2.9 billion senior secured loan for Perpetua Resources' Stibnite Gold-Antimony Project in Idaho — EXIM's fourth-largest loan on record and biggest under its 'Make More in America' initiative. The mine hosts America's only reported domestic antimony reserve; China currently supplies 50%+ of US demand for the critical mineral used in munitions, semiconductors and solar panels.
